source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of chapter 5 exercise (PDF 150-152, printed 147-149).

blocks.text: Is exercise mein 9 multiple choice, 6 short aur 6 long sawal hain. Har short aur long sawal apne topic ke Roman Urdu lesson mein self-check ki shakal mein hal kiya gaya hai.
1. Neeche mein se bunyadi statistical model ki misal kaunsi hai?

items: a) Linear Regression
b) Neural Networks
c) Decision Trees
d) Support Vector Machines

blocks.text: 2. Data science mein experimental design mein kya hota hai?

items: a) Visualizations banana
b) Data ko munazzam tareeqe se jama karna aur jaiza lena
c) Machine learning ka code likhna
d) Databases banana

blocks.text: 3. Neeche mein se kaunsi data visualization ki qism NAHI hai?

items: a) Bar Chart
b) Scatter Plot
c) Hypothesis Test
d) Heatmap

blocks.text: 4. Data visualizations banane ke liye aam taur par kaunsa tool istemal hota hai?

items: a) MS Excel
b) Python (Matplotlib)
c) Tableau
d) Yeh sab (All of the above)

blocks.text: 5. Linear regression model mein slope kya dikhata hai?

items: a) Model ka intercept
b) Independent variable ki ek unit badalne par dependent variable ki tabdeeli
c) Error term
d) Data ka mean

blocks.text: 6. Statistical models ke asal duniya ke istemal ki misal kaunsi hai?

items: a) Gharon ki qeematon ki pesh-goi
b) Social media posts banana
c) Websites design karna
d) Essays likhna

blocks.text: 7. Neeche mein se data visualization ka kaunsa faida NAHI hai?

items: a) Trends aur patterns pehchanna
b) Baat wazeh tareeqe se samjhana
c) Data ko zyada complex banana
d) Bare datasets ka khulasa

blocks.text: 8. K-Means Clustering ka bunyadi maqsad kya hai?

items: a) Data ko pehle se tay categories mein classify karna
b) Data ko milte julte pan ki bunyad par clusters mein group karna
c) Lagataar (continuous) nataij ki pesh-goi
d) Data ki dimensions kam karna

blocks.text: 9. K-Means Clustering mein “K” kya dikhata hai?

items: a) Dataset mein features ki tadaad
b) Banne wale clusters ki tadaad
c) Convergence ke liye zaroori iterations ki tadaad
d) Dataset mein data points ki tadaad

items: Asal duniya mein statistical models banane ki kya ahmiyat hai? (hal: topic 5.1.1)
Pesh-goi ke liye ek bunyadi statistical model ka naam le kar us ka maqsad bataiye. (hal: topic 5.4.1.2)
Data visualization ki do qismein bata kar likhiye ke har ek kab istemal karenge. (hal: topic 5.5.1)
Data ka visualization descriptive statistics samajhne mein kaise madad deta hai? (hal: topic 5.2.2)
Data visualization ke liye MS Excel jaise tools istemal karne ka kya maqsad hai? (hal: topic 5.6.1)
Asal duniya ka aisa masla bataiye jahan statistical model lag sakta ho. (hal: topic 5.1.3)
Asal duniya ke masail hal karne mein statistical models ka kirdar aur ahmiyat samjhaiye. (hal: topic 5.1.2)
Bunyadi statistical model (maslan linear regression) banane ke qadam bataiye: data collection, training aur evaluation samait. (hal: topic 5.4.1.1)
Data visualizations ki qismein aur un ke istemal par bahas kijiye. (hal: topic 5.6.2)
Statistical modeling mein model evaluation ka concept samjhaiye. (hal: topic 5.4.2)

K-Means Clustering algorithm qadam ba qadam samjhaiye: shuruati centroids kaise chune jate hain, data points clusters mein kaise rakhe jate hain aur centroids kaise update hote hain. (hal: topic 5.4.2.3)
Asal duniya ki aisi soorat bataiye jahan K-Means Clustering lag sakti ho; data ki tayyari, K ka intikhab aur nataij ki samajh bayan kijiye. (hal: topic 5.4.2.3B, K-means class activity)
